messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: hi, can you help me\nassistant: Of course! I'm here to help. However, I might need more context or information about what you're looking for. Could you please provide more details about your question or request?\nuser: what's the difference between debit and credit cards\nassistant:   A debit card takes the funds directly from your  checking account when you make a purchase. There's no loan or credit involved, it's just your money being spent.  A credit card facilitates a short term loan. When you make a purchase with a credit card, you're essentially borrowing money from the bank, which you then pay back later.\nuser: how do I select a credit card, there are so many choices, it is overwhelming\nassistant: I understand that choosing a credit card can be overwhelming due to the variety of options available. Here are some tips that might help you: 1. Look for a card that gives you the best rewards without charging you an annual or other fees. 2. Make sure the card delivers on the benefits you expect. Also, ensure that the best earnings aren't only from shopping at one gas station or one store, as you may not make as much as you expect.\nuser: Discover card is a good option.",
    "answer": "The documents don’t provide enough information to determine whether Discover is a good option for you. They note that some U.S. merchants don’t accept Discover because the fee charged to the store is higher than average. [S2] Which Discover card are you considering, and do you plan to pay your balance in full each month?"
}
Output:

statements: The documents do not provide enough information to determine whether Discover is a good credit card option for the user.
The documents state that some U.S. merchants do not accept Discover.
The documents attribute the lack of Discover acceptance among some U.S. merchants to higher-than-average merchant fees.
The assistant asks the user to identify the Discover card under consideration.
The assistant asks whether the user plans to pay the credit card balance in full each month.
